verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs show it can accept online card payments, through the Checkout /sessions integration, payment links and a test environment. Nothing in the evidence shows a self-serve signup that lets a founder go live within a day. The only time-to-acceptance evidence comes from the community, which reports that Adyen refuses small clients, imposes minimum volumes and reserves, and that integrations took hundreds of hours. That leaves the core of the story, live acceptance within a day of signup, unevidenced.

support.subject: As a founder, I can accept an online card payment within a day of signing up
